subject: [hw] DONE V33 rev 4
body:
Rev 4: tests plus one small error-fidelity fix, no interface change. 306 checks (was 298).

Fixed: fopen() now propagates the actual string error from the guest path/mode copy (ENAMETOOLONG for a >1023-byte path) instead of collapsing it to EFAULT, matching open(). Two new areas: a read into an MMIO megabyte must be EFAULT (the buffer check rejects MMIO), and a 2047-byte path is ENAMETOOLONG(36) from open() and fopen().

  bash gpu/hwcodec/shim/test_v33/run_tests.sh
    N2TEST V33-TABLE PASS 27/27
    N2TEST V33 PASS 306/306   (ASan+UBSan -O1)
    N2TEST V33 PASS 306/306   (plain -O2)
    N2TEST V33 PASS 306/306   (TSan -O1)

Everything else from rev 2/3 stands (V30 F15 reported and not ours; full shim set links unresolved=0).
